tools.name: finale_list_facilities
tools.description: List Finale locations and sublocations: facilityName, facilityUrl (use it in other tools), parentFacilityUrl (set for sublocations), status. GET /{account}/api/facility/.

tools.name: finale_list_products
tools.description: List products (SKUs): productId, internalName, status, productUrl, manufacturer, UPC, packing. Optional exact filters on productId and status. Collections come back ordered by lastUpdatedDate; for large catalogs narrow with updated_since or page with next_updated_since. GET /{account}/api/product/.

tools.name: finale_get_product
tools.description: One product in full: ids, description, UPC/ASIN, dimensions and weight, cost, supplier list, reorder guidelines, price list, custom fields. GET /{account}/api/product/{id} (falls back to a productId filter when the resource URL differs).

tools.name: finale_list_orders
tools.description: List orders without their line items: orderId, type (SALES_ORDER or PURCHASE_ORDER), status (ORDER_CREATED, ORDER_LOCKED = committed, ORDER_COMPLETED, ORDER_CANCELLED), dates, origin/destination facility, reference number, total. Get the items with finale_get_order. For a large order history always

tools.name: finale_get_order
tools.description: One order in full: header, line items (productUrl, quantity, unitPrice), roles (customer or supplier), adjustments, shipment and invoice URLs, notes. GET /{account}/api/order/{orderId}.

tools.name: finale_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments (sales shipments, purchase receipts, transfers): shipmentId, type, status (for example SHIPMENT_INPUT, SHIPMENT_PACKED, SHIPMENT_SHIPPED), order, origin/destination, dates, tracking code. GET /{account}/api/shipment/.

tools.name: finale_get_shipment
tools.description: One shipment in full, including its shipment items (product, facility, quantity), packages and transfers. GET /{account}/api/shipment/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: finale_list_parties
tools.description: List party groups (customers, suppliers, carriers): partyId (derived from partyUrl; use it as supplier_party_id when drafting a purchase order), name (description), type, roles, status. GET /{account}/api/partygroup/.

tools.name: finale_list_inventory_items
tools.description: Current stock as Finale stores it: one entry per product, location, lot and order with quantityOnHand, quantityOnOrder (committed purchase orders) and quantityReserved (committed sales orders). tools.name: finale_get_product_stock
tools.description: Stock of one product summed over Finale's stock entries: totals for quantityOnHand, quantityOnOrder and quantityReserved, and the same per location/sublocation. Downloads the WHOLE inventoryitem collection (Finale offers no filter; large on big accounts), so it counts as one collection read of the 3

tools.name: finale_list_inventory_transfers
tools.description: List stock transfers between locations: product, from/to facility, quantity, lot, send and receive dates. GET /{account}/api/inventorytransfer/.

tools.name: finale_list_stock_changes
tools.description: List stock changes (physical counts and adjustments already recorded in Finale): id, type, date, status, location, comments. Read-only history. GET /{account}/api/inventoryvariance/.

tools.name: finale_create_draft_purchase_order
tools.description: WRITE. Creates a purchase order for a supplier in status ORDER_CREATED, i.e. an editable draft. It is NOT locked (committed), received, completed or emailed, no stock changes and no money moves: review and commit it in Finale. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: finale_get_product, finale_get_order, finale_list_stock_changes, finale_create_draft_purchase_order · Public sink: finale_list_inventory_transfers, finale_create_draft_purchase_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: finale_get_product, finale_get_order, finale_list_stock_changes, finale_create_draft_purchase_order · Public sink: finale_list_inventory_transfers, finale_create_draft_purchase_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
